info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Delete P2m By Merchant Id-spec
info.description: This API allows the deletion of merchant-specific P2M transactions identified by the unique merchant ID. It ensures the effective management of transaction records for merchants by enabling the removal of unnecessary or erroneous entries. Typical consumers of this API include financial institutions, payment processors, and merchants who wish to maintain accurate transaction data. By leveraging this endpoint, users can streamline their records and maintain compliance with relevant financial regulations.

delete.summary: Remove a merchant from the system.
delete.description: This operation allows you to delete a specific merchant identified by its unique ID. Once deleted, the merchant's data will be permanently removed from the system.

requestBody.description: Request body for deleting the merchant with the ID 'MER-800045'. This body should contain any necessary payload required to confirm the deletion operation. Ensure that the structure matches the specified schema.

204.description: The resource has been successfully deleted with no content to return.
